representation.name: Codex DESeq2 DEG symbols CBD cisplatin vs DMSO
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
cat > analysis.R <<'RSCRIPT'
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DESeq2))
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
counts_path <- args[[1]]
layout_path <- args[[2]]
map_path <- args[[3]]
counts <- read.csv(counts_path, row.names=1, check.names=FALSE)
layout <- read.csv(layout_path, stringsAsFactors=FALSE, check.names=FALSE)
map <- read.delim(map_path, stringsAsFactors=FALSE, check.names=FALSE)
layout$CountColumn <- gsub('-', '_', layout$SampleID, fixed=TRUE)
target <- 'Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50'
control <- 'DMSO'
keep <- layout$Group %in% c(control, target)
sel <- layout[keep, , drop=FALSE]
if (nrow(sel) != 6) stop('Expected exactly 3 DMSO and 3 target samples')
if (!all(sel$CountColumn %in% colnames(counts))) stop('Sample IDs do not match count columns')
sel <- sel[order(match(sel$Group, c(control, target)), sel$CountColumn), , drop=FALSE]
count_mat <- as.matrix(counts[, sel$CountColumn, drop=FALSE])
storage.mode(count_mat) <- 'integer'
colnames(count_mat) <- sel$CountColumn
coldata <- data.frame(row.names=sel$CountColumn, Group=factor(sel$Group, levels=c(control, target)))
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData=count_mat, colData=coldata, design=~Group)
dds <- DESeq(dds, quiet=TRUE)
res <- results(dds, contrast=c('Group', target, control), alpha=0.05)
res_df <- as.data.frame(res)
res_df$ENSG <- rownames(res_df)
res_df <- res_df[, c('ENSG', setdiff(colnames(res_df), 'ENSG'))]
colnames(map)[1:2] <- c('ENSG', 'gene_name')
res_df <- merge(res_df, map[, c('ENSG','gene_name')], by='ENSG', all.x=TRUE, sort=FALSE)
res_df <- res_df[, c('ENSG','gene_name','baseMean','log2FoldChange','lfcSE','stat','pvalue','padj')]
write.table(res_df, file='deseq2_results_mapped.tsv', sep='\t', quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE, na='')
deg <- res_df[!is.na(res_df$padj) & res_df$padj < 0.05 & !is.na(res_df$log2FoldChange) & abs(res_df$log2FoldChange) >= 0.5 & !is.na(res_df$gene_name) & res_df$gene_name != '', , drop=FALSE]
genes <- unique(deg$gene_name)
writeLines(genes, con='deg_gene_symbols.txt')
summary <- data.frame(parameter=c('method','contrast','alpha','padj_threshold','abs_log2fc_threshold','n_degs_mapped_unique_symbols'), value=c('DESeq2', paste(target, 'vs', control), '0.05', '0.05', '0.5', as.character(length(genes))))
write.table(summary, file='deg_summary.tsv', sep='\t', quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE)
RSCRIPT
Rscript analysis.R "$(inputs.counts.path)" "$(inputs.layout.path)" "$(inputs.mapping.path)"

set -eu
cat > analysis.R <<'RSCRIPT'
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DESeq2))
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
counts_path <- args[[1]]
layout_path <- args[[2]]
map_path <- args[[3]]
counts <- read.csv(counts_path, row.names=1, check.names=FALSE)
layout <- read.csv(layout_path, stringsAsFactors=FALSE, check.names=FALSE)
map <- read.delim(map_path, stringsAsFactors=FALSE, check.names=FALSE)
layout$CountColumn <- gsub('-', '_', layout$SampleID, fixed=TRUE)
target <- 'Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50'
control <- 'DMSO'
keep <- layout$Group %in% c(control, target)
sel <- layout[keep, , drop=FALSE]
if (nrow(sel) != 6) stop('Expected exactly 3 DMSO and 3 target samples')
if (!all(sel$CountColumn %in% colnames(counts))) stop('Sample IDs do not match count columns')
sel <- sel[order(match(sel$Group, c(control, target)), sel$CountColumn), , drop=FALSE]
count_mat <- as.matrix(counts[, sel$CountColumn, drop=FALSE])
storage.mode(count_mat) <- 'integer'
colnames(count_mat) <- sel$CountColumn
coldata <- data.frame(row.names=sel$CountColumn, Group=factor(sel$Group, levels=c(control, target)))
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData=count_mat, colData=coldata, design=~Group)
dds <- DESeq(dds, quiet=TRUE)
res <- results(dds, contrast=c('Group', target, control), alpha=0.05)
res_df <- as.data.frame(res)
res_df$ENSG <- rownames(res_df)
res_df <- res_df[, c('ENSG', setdiff(colnames(res_df), 'ENSG'))]
colnames(map)[1:2] <- c('ENSG', 'gene_name')
res_df <- merge(res_df, map[, c('ENSG','gene_name')], by='ENSG', all.x=TRUE, sort=FALSE)
res_df <- res_df[, c('ENSG','gene_name','baseMean','log2FoldChange','lfcSE','stat','pvalue','padj')]
write.table(res_df, file='deseq2_results_mapped.tsv', sep='\t', quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE, na='')
deg <- res_df[!is.na(res_df$padj) & res_df$padj < 0.05 & !is.na(res_df$log2FoldChange) & abs(res_df$log2FoldChange) >= 0.5 & !is.na(res_df$gene_name) & res_df$gene_name != '', , drop=FALSE]
genes <- unique(deg$gene_name)
writeLines(genes, con='deg_gene_symbols.txt')
summary <- data.frame(parameter=c('method','contrast','alpha','padj_threshold','abs_log2fc_threshold','n_degs_mapped_unique_symbols'), value=c('DESeq2', paste(target, 'vs', control), '0.05', '0.05', '0.5', as.character(length(genes))))
write.table(summary, file='deg_summary.tsv', sep='\t', quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE)
RSCRIPT
